image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel) emerging from behind a textured tree trunk on the left. The animal has reddish-brown fur on its back and head, with a distinct white/cream underbelly and throat. Its body is elongated and slender, stretching horizontally to the right. The head features a pointed snout, small dark eye, and rounded ear. The background is a soft-focus mix of grey rocks and green vegetation.

A small, dark, bead-like eye is visible on the side of the head, consistent with the species' anatomy.
The visible ear is short, broad at the base, and rounded at the tip, lacking the pointedness of some other mustelids.
